_README: Two shapes are accepted. (1) A flat Cookie-Editor export: a JSON array of {name, value, expirationDate, ...} → treated as one account labeled 'default'. (2) Multi-account: {"accounts": [{"label": "...", "entries": [...cookie-editor entries...]}, ...]}. Multi-account is round-robin across requests, so each account should belong to a different FB user to view posts from each account's friends/groups.
